description: Pulls recent bugs from Jira Data Center (JIRA_BASE_URL + JIRA_PAT from the environment), drops bugs that already carry the [bug-template-check] reminder, and pre-computes the DEV/QUA/PROD hit per bug. No model call.

params.label: JQL
params.description: Default: project = <KEY> AND issuetype = Bug AND created >= -24h ORDER BY created DESC. For backlog only append: AND sprint is EMPTY AND statusCategory != Done (before ORDER BY).
params.default: project = <KEY> AND issuetype = Bug AND created >= -24h ORDER BY created DESC

params.label: Fixture file (testing only)
params.description: Path to a JSON file with a Jira search response (or an issues array). When set, Jira is not called. Leave empty in real runs.
